name: Zane Egginton
story: Zane Egginton's 2025 University of Auckland Master of Design research, Weaving Tikanga and Technology: Pathways to Natural Hazard Resilience, explored approaches joining tikanga and geospatial technology in natural-hazard resilience. The university's institutional research record supports the qualification and topic. This profile does not reproduce unpublished cultural records or presume publication rights for project data.
